Question: Consider equation I: \(x+y+z=46,\) where \(x,\) \(y,\) and \(z\) are positive integers, and equation II: \(x+y+z+w=46,\) where \(x,\) \(y,\) \(z,\) and \(w\) are positive integers. Then:

Choices.A: \(\mathrm{I}\) can be solved in consecutive integers
Choices.B: \(\mathrm{I}\) can be solved in consecutive even integers
Choices.C:
\(\mathrm{II}\) can be solved in consecutive
integers
Choices.D: \(\mathrm{II}\) can be solved in consecutive even integers
Choices.E: \(\mathrm{II}\) can be solved in consecutive odd integers
